pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR0126 first-release completion on the existing Timeline runtime and Project Rust boundary. Adds an Editor-native `*.timeline.json` asset kind with create/open routing and a typed Sequencer surface backed exclusively by `TimelineAuthoringService` commands.

The Sequencer includes searchable track creation, track/lane and marker/event presentation, clip move/resize/duplicate/delete, numeric property curve editing, frame/marker/clip-edge/playhead snapping feedback, binding diagnostics with Scene focus, transient mute/solo/lock, Play/Pause/Stop/Step/Loop controls, and inline ReplayRequired/NonSeekable badges. Asset-backed Animation/Audio/VFX clip creation remains typed rather than fabricating placeholder stable references.

The PR remains Draft while persistent Scene View Timeline sampling, final Windows Validation, and Visual Validation are completed.
